description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductOptionValueService interface, providing CRUD operations and additional logic for managing product option values in the e-commerce system. It interacts with DAO and other services to handle product attribute relationships and store-specific data.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing product option values, extending generic service features and providing custom methods for store-specific retrieval, deletion, and code-based lookup.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product option values associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product option values for a store with read-only access.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a product option value by store and ID, with exception handling.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves product option values matching the given name for a store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing product option value.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product option value and associated product attributes from the store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option value by code for a store.
